summary.text: Michele Vetter is the Republican candidate for Tennessee House of Representatives District 52 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Justin Jones and independent Martez Coleman.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a community organizer, advocate, business owner and long-term resident.

paragraphs.text: Vetter advanced from the Republican primary on August 6, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she listed conservation, community protection, safety, education, healthcare, infrastructure and growth management as her policy interests.
Her campaign messages, as she listed them, include a return to effective representation for all and a culture of working together for safer, cleaner and greener communities.
